_comment: Public affiliate IDs. Not secrets. Leave a value empty until the program approves you; stores without all required IDs fall back to a plain, non-affiliate link. Kobo runs on Rakuten Advertising: kobo_partner_id is our Rakuten link ID, kobo_merchant_id 37217 is the approved Kobo US program (the Brazil program, 40380, is a separate approval and is not used). Awin: awin_publisher_id is your account; awin_bookshop_mid (92005) and awin_librofm_mid (25361) are filled in only after Awin approves each program.
